title: Script
empty: Paste a script or load a file (.txt / .csv / .tsv), then press “Create script”. Assign a voice to each speaker and render line by line.

source.title: Script
source.placeholder:
太郎：おはよう。
花子：「おはようございます」
（二人は歩き出す）
太郎：いい天気だね。
source.textHint: One line of text per line of dialogue, as “speaker：line”, “speaker: line” or “speaker「line」”. A line without a speaker continues the previous speaker; lines only in parentheses (stage directions) are not spoken.
source.tableHint: The first row must be a header (index, speaker, text, caption, candidates, seed, pause_ms, file — Japanese headers work too). Without a header, the first column is the speaker and the second the line.
source.replaceConfirm: Replacing discards every current line and all rendered audio. Continue?

importErrors.empty: No lines found. Check that the text is written as “speaker: line”, or that a table has a header row and lines.
importErrors.header: The table's header row has no text column (“text” or “セリフ”).
importErrors.value: Row {{row}} of the table has an invalid “{{column}}”. Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
importErrors.range: Line {{line}} is out of range (text up to 1000 characters, candidates 1–32, pause up to 10000 ms).

speakers.title: Speakers and voices
speakers.hint: Assign a library voice to each speaker. The voice's defaults (caption, parameters, seed, LoRA) apply; the settings below and each line's own values take precedence.
speakers.name: Speaker
speakers.caption: Caption (all of this speaker's lines)
speakers.noVoiceWarning: A speaker without a voice may sound different from line to line.

settings.title: Settings
settings.scriptTitleHint: Names the merged audio and subtitle files, and fills {title} in the template.
settings.pauseHint: Silence placed after each line when joining. Each line can set its own pause.
settings.subtitleSpeakers: Put speaker names in the subtitles (speaker: line)
settings.paramsHint: Values changed here apply to every line. Values left at the default use each speaker's voice defaults. Candidates and seed can also be set per line.
settings.unsaved: There are unsaved changes (they are saved automatically before rendering or exporting).

lines.title: Lines
lines.emojiHint: Click into a line's text, then pick an emoji to insert it at the cursor.
lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.truncated: Reached the {{limit}} s limit; the end may be cut off.
lines.fileNameHint: Leave empty to use the template's name.
lines.deleteConfirmTakes: Delete this line and its rendered audio?
lines.confirmChange: Changing the text or speaker discards this line's rendered audio.

render.cancelled: Cancelled. “Render remaining lines” continues where it stopped.

export.title: Join and export
export.incomplete_one: {{count}} line is not rendered yet. Render every line to join and export.
export.incomplete_other: {{count}} lines are not rendered yet. Render every line to join and export.
export.overwrite: Files of the same name in the chosen folder are overwritten.
export.tableTitle: Save the script as a table
export.tableHint: For game engines and spreadsheets. Loading it back into this app gives the same lines.
